name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Implement the quantum order-finding core
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Implement the quantum order-finding core of Shor's algorithm in Qiskit to factor N=15 with base a=13: build controlled modular multiplication by permutation gates, run QPE, and extract the period with continued fractions to recover the factors. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
